question_text: A 75-year-old woman is being treated for atrial fibrillation. She presents to the clinic with complaints of nausea, vomiting, photophobia, and yellow-green vision with yellow halos around the lights. She has a heart rate of 64/min, blood pressure is 118/76 mm Hg, and respiratory rate is 15/min. Physical examination reveals regular heart sounds with clear lung sounds bilaterally. Liver function tests are normal. Toxicity of which of the following anti-arrhythmic drugs would best fit this clinical picture?
